items.title: Scaling agentic AI across the enterprise with Amazon Quick
items.text:
Key takeaways:
Many companies are struggling with disconnected AI tools and workflow, lack of access to data, and business value that doesn’t often spread beyond one team.Amazon Quick combines deterministic (rules-based) and non-deterministic (AI) in a single, low-code agentic platform with human-in-the-loop throughout.PwC is helping organizations across industries leverage Amazon Quick, including two large enterprises based in the US.The results are concrete. A financial services CIO’s investment assessment dropped from weeks or months to days, and a tech company’s sales team is cutting an administrative load that consumed over 60% of sellers’ days.PwC pairs Quick with workforce readiness, governance, and business value realization so AI scales beyond isolated wins.
